_comment: REL-896 cross-language run-secret naming contract. `valid` entries are generated by calling the canonical TypeScript writer, buildRunSecretName (src/k8s/reviewJobProjection.ts), for the listed (runId, executionAttempt) pair -- see tests/unit/reviewJobProjectionSecretNameContract.test.ts. `invalid` is a list of deliberately non-conforming names. Both the TypeScript reader (deriveRunSecretExecutionAttempt) and the Go reader (job.IsValidRunSecretName) load this same file, so a change to the naming scheme on either side that is not mirrored on the other fails immediately here instead of leaking a run Secret in production. Regenerate this file (recompute `name` from buildRunSecretName for each entry) whenever the TS naming scheme changes, then let the Go test fail until pkg/job/job.go's secretNamePattern is updated to match.
